sources.snippet: YOLACT-ResNet50 — Real-time instance segmentation (LiteRT GPU) Per-object instance segmentation (COCO 80 classes) running fully on the LiteRT CompiledModel GPU. YOLACT (ICCV 2019): the network (ResNet50 + FPN + protonet + heads) runs on the GPU; the lightweight decode (NMS + linear-combination masks) runs host-side. The first instance-segmentation model in this zoo. ~41 ms/graph on a Pixel 8a.
